posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Tachyon was a one-woman army, playing Hypersonic Assault three rounds in a row, successfully experimenting on herself every round, and inspired by Mirai Nagasu, landing a triple Lightspeed Barrage for full technical points.

 

Chrono-Ranger quickly slapped bounties on Ambuscade, which added to Tachyon's display of force and grace. Bunker and Parse hung out on the sidelines, leading the Mars Base scientists in the "U-S-A, U-S-A" chant.

 

After his defeat, Ambusdace slipped away swearing that next time, a different Red, White and Blue flag would be on top of the Mars Base Medal stand.

 

HP at end: Tachyon 15HP, Chrono-Ranger 15HP, Bunker 18HP, Parse 11HP.

posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Mint. Ambuscade opened Mine / Hand-Cannon / Cloaking Device, then played Charged Attacks. Tachyon blew up Charged Attacks and used her base power on Parse, which gave me Gauge and Buffer Overflow. Chrono-Ranger put Kill on Sight on the Cloaking Device, Bunker shot it with Flak Cannon, and Parse Recompiled her hand.

The environment played Meteor Storm turn 1 and Ambuscade played most of his deck afterward (Armed and Dangerous into Armed and Dangerous into all of his traps), eventually leaving him with 9 cards in deck. Two of them were Vanish, two of them would reshuffle trash into deck, and the other five were either devices or one-shots like Snatch and Grab.

From there, I said “screw it” and hid behind Meteor Storm. Tachyon played Research Grant and started burning through her deck with passed powers from Parse. Chrono-Ranger and Bunker got out as much equipment as possible in case of Pervasive Red Dust. Parse sifted Ambuscade’s deck and buried both of his trash-into-deck reshuffles.

When I had two turns left before a guaranteed Ambuscade reshuffle, I knew Snatch and Grab was coming, so I played Adhesive Foam Grenade, destroyed Meteor Storm, finished off the cloak, let him wail on me with all his devices for one turn, then Tachyon played a triple Lightspeed Barrage to one-turn-kill him.

Most use I’ve ever had out of Gauge.

Final HP 11, 16, 13, 16

posts.cooked: Mint, but no real issue. Everyone focused on taking out his devices in the first rounds, even though both reactive plates came out and his cloaking device popped up two turns in a row. I used Lightning Barrage on the cloaking device on one turn just to get it out of the way. Chrono-Ranger used "Just Doing my Job" to get set up pretty well so by the time I could finally focus on Ambuscade, he had his hat, Compound Bow, Hunter and Hunted and a handful of bounties out which made it easy to do 20+ damage in a turn. Parse had Snap Decision, Recompile and Critical Multiplier to add her own fair share of damage. Parse also gave Chrono-Ranger extra power plays so Ambuscade quickly fell down after that. Everyone was in their teens.
